description: Look up Japan's applied customs tariff rates by HS code: the line description and the general, temporary, WTO, GSP and LDC duty rates, the rate under each economic partnership agreement (CPTPP, EU, UK, RCEP, ASEAN, Australia, India, Switzerland and others, plus the JP-US trade agreement) and the quantity units. Accepts a 2-digit chapter, 4-digit heading (e.g. 0713 dried legumes), 6-digit subheading or 9-digit statistical code, with or without dots; a longer foreign code is cut to its first 6 digits. Answers 'what duty does Japan charge on this HS code', 'Japan import tariff on X', 'Japan EPA preferential rate for Y'. Returns the schedule edition date; an unknown code returns found:false.

hs_code.description: HS code, 2 to 9 digits, dots optional (e.g. "0713", "0713.32", "071332010"). Codes longer than 9 digits are cut to 6.

partner.description: Optional trade-agreement partner to keep in epa_rates, e.g. "cptpp", "eu", "uk", "india", "rcep", "viet_nam", "australia".

name: jp_tariff_lookup
